pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Some stories in the Bible are strange. Really strange. A bush that burns but does not burn up. A man who wrestles with a stranger all night in the dirt. A ladder with angels going up and down. A donkey that talks. A hand that writes on a wall. If you have ever read the Old Testament and thought, "What is going on here?" you are not alone. A lot of people feel that way.


But here is the secret. Those strange stories are not random. They are not just weird tales from long ago. They are clues. They are breadcrumbs. They are hidden pictures of someone who was coming. Someone who would show up in a bush. In a wrestler. In a ladder. In a fire. And that someone is Jesus.


This book is for the curious. It is for the person who senses there is more. It is for the seeker who is tired of surface answers and wants to dig into the strange, beautiful, mysterious parts of the Bible. You do not need a theology degree. You do not need to know Hebrew. You just need to be willing to look closer.


Over the next 30 days, we will look at 30 of the strangest stories in the Old Testament. We will ask the question, "What is really going on here?" And we will find that every single one is hiding a picture of Jesus. Not a hidden code. Not a secret message. A person. The one the whole book is about.


Get ready. Some of these stories will surprise you. Some will make you laugh. Some will make you stop and stare. All of them will point you to Him.



The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not read the Old Testament the same way. You will stop skimming the strange parts. You will slow down. You will look closer. You will see Jesus hiding in places you never expected. In a wrestling match. In a talking donkey. In a hand on a wall. In...

pages.body:
The Hook


A bush on fire. Flames everywhere. But the bush does not burn up. It stays green. It stays whole. Moses saw it and thought, "I have to look at this." That is the whole story of the Bible. Something strange. Something beautiful. Something that makes you stop and look closer.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up. So Moses thought, 'I will go over and see this strange sight, why the bush does not burn.'" - Exodus 3:2-3


This is the first strange story we will look at. A bush. Fire. No ash. No smoke damage. It was a miracle. It was a sign. And it was a picture. God was in the fire. God was in the bush. And the fire did not destroy it. The presence of God does not destroy. It fills. It makes holy. It makes alive. The bush was a body of fire. God's presence inside something He chose.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son." - John 1:14


God in a bush. God in a body. The bush was a picture. The body was the reality. Jesus is the burning bush. He is God in a form you can see. He is the fire in the bush. He is the presence in the person. The bush did not burn up. Jesus was not destroyed. He came out of the grave. The fire did not consume the bush. The grave did not consume Jesus. The pattern is the same.


The Verdict


The bush is a shadow. The body is the substance. The fire is the presence. The person is Jesus. This is not a coincidence. It is a clue. The bush that would not burn is a picture of the Christ who would not stay dead.


The Resonance


Do you feel like the fire is too hot? Like the flames will consume you? Look at the bush. It stayed green. God's presence does not destroy you. It fills you. It makes you holy. You will not burn up. You will come out. You will be alive.


The Prayer


God, thank you that your fire does not destroy me. Thank you that you fill me and do not burn me. Thank you for the bush. Thank you for the picture. Thank you for Jesus. Live in me. Make me holy. I am not afraid of the fire. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook


Have you ever been so desperate you would grab onto something and not let go? Jacob was. He was about to face his brother who wanted to kill him. That night, a stranger came. And they wrestled. All night. In the dark. In the dirt. And Jacob would not let go.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak... Then the man said, 'Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.'" - Genesis 32:24, 28


This is one of the strangest stories in the Bible. A man wrestles with God. In the dark. In the dirt. And God lets him win? Not exactly. God lets him hold on. God lets him struggle. God lets him grab. The man is God. The text says so. Jacob struggled with God. And he held on. He said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me." And God blessed him. And he walked away with a limp.


This is not a distant God. This is a God who lets you grab Him.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But we see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death." - Hebrews 2:9


Jacob wrestled a man. The man was God. God let Himself be grabbed. God let Himself be held. He could have broken free. He did not. This is a picture of Jesus. Jesus let Himself be grabbed, beaten, and held on a cross. He did not break free. He let Himself be held. For us. The wrestler is a shadow. The cross is the substance.


The Verdict


The wrestler is a shadow. The cross is the substance. God lets Himself be grabbed. God lets Himself be held. God lets Himself be wounded. For us. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you struggling? Are you angry? Do you want to grab God and shout? Do it. He can handle it. He is not fragile. Jacob held on and did not let go. Hold on. Even in the dark. Even in the dirt. He is there. He will bless you.


The Prayer


God, I am struggling. I am not going to let go. I am holding on to you. Even if I limp away, I am not letting go until you bless me. You are worth holding. You are worth the fight. I am not letting go. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook


Jacob was running away. He was scared. He was alone. He used a rock for a pillow. He fell asleep in the desert. And he dreamed. He saw a ladder. It was a ladder that reached from earth to heaven. Angels were going up and down on it. And God was at the top. This is one of the strangest pictures in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it." - Genesis 28:12


A ladder. A stairway. From earth to heaven. Angels going up and down. This is a picture of connection. Heaven and earth were not far apart. They were connected. There was a way. There was a stairway. There was a path. And God was at the top. This is a strange story. But it is a beautiful one. It is a picture of a connection that was always there.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"He then added, 'Very truly I tell you, you will see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.'" - John 1:51


Jesus said the ladder was Him. He is the stairway. He is the connection. He is the way between heaven and earth. He is the path between God and man. The ladder was a shadow. Jesus is the substance. The angels were going up and down on the ladder. They go up and down on the Son of Man. He is the connection. He is the way.


The Verdict


The ladder is a shadow. The Son of Man is the substance. He is the connection. He is the way. He is the stairway. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel disconnected from God? Do you feel like there is a gap? Do you feel like there is a distance? Remember the ladder. Remember Jesus. He is the connection. He is the way. He is the bridge. You can climb. You can come up. He made a way.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the ladder. You are the stairway. You are the connection. Thank you for making a way between heaven and earth. Thank you for making a way between me and God. I am climbing. I am coming up. I am with you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: The Ladder to Heaven

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


This is the strangest story in the Bible. A donkey talks. A real donkey. It opens its mouth and speaks. To a prophet. And the prophet argues with it. This is so weird it almost sounds like a joke. But it is in the Bible. And it is hiding a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Then the LORD opened the donkey's mouth, and it said to Balaam, 'What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?'" - Numbers 22:28


Balaam was a prophet. He was on his way to curse God's people. He was riding a donkey. The donkey saw an angel. The donkey stopped. Balaam beat it. And the donkey spoke. It asked a question. "What have I done to you?" The donkey saw what the prophet could not. The donkey was smarter than the man. This is a strange story. But it is a story about sight. The donkey saw. The prophet was blind. And God used a donkey to save a prophet.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


God uses the foolish. God uses the weak. God used a donkey. God used a baby. God used a carpenter. God used fishermen. God uses the things the world would throw away. The donkey is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The foolish thing. The weak thing. The thing that saves. The donkey is a picture of Jesus. The one the world rejected. The one God used to save.


The Verdict


The donkey is a shadow. The rejected one is the substance. God uses the foolish. God uses the weak. God uses the rejected. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel like a donkey? Like the foolish one? Like the weak one? Like the rejected one? God uses the foolish. God uses the weak. God uses the rejected. You are not too small. You are not too dumb. You are not too weak. God can speak through you. God can use you. He did it with a donkey.


The Prayer


God, I feel like a donkey. I feel foolish. I feel weak. I feel rejected. But you use the foolish. You use the weak. You use the rejected. Use me. Speak through me. I am yours. I am ready. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Talking Donkey

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


A king was having a party. He was drinking. He was mocking God. He was using the sacred cups from the temple. And then he saw it. A hand. Writing on the wall. A finger. Writing letters. In the air. The king was terrified. His knees knocked. His face went pale. This is one of the strangest and scariest stories in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Suddenly the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall, near the lampstand in the royal palace. The king watched the hand as it wrote. His face turned pale and he was so frightened that his legs became weak and his knees were knocking." - Daniel 5:5-6


A hand appeared. A finger wrote. On the wall. In the palace. In front of the king. The message was judgment. The king was weighed and found wanting. The hand was God's. The finger was God's. The writing was God's. God showed up. In person. In a hand. In a finger. In letters. This is strange. This is scary. This is God.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Then the Jews demanded of him, 'What miraculous sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?' Jesus answered them, 'Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.'" - John 2:18-19


A hand wrote on a wall. A finger wrote on the ground. When the woman caught in adultery was brought to Jesus, He wrote on the ground with His finger. The same finger. The same God. He wrote judgment once. He wrote grace once. The finger is the same. The God is the same. The hand on the wall is a shadow. The finger on the ground is the substance. Jesus is the finger of God.


The Verdict


The hand is a shadow. The finger is the substance. God writes. God speaks. God shows up. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Is God writing on your wall? Is He trying to get your attention? Is He speaking? Do not ignore it. The hand was a warning. It was a message. God is speaking to you. Listen. He is writing. He is showing up. Do not be like the king. Do not be found wanting. Respond.


The Prayer


God, I see your hand. I hear your voice. I do not want to be found wanting. I do not want to ignore you. Write on my heart. Write your truth. Write your grace. I am listening. I am responding. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Hand on the Wall

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Three men were thrown into a furnace. It was so hot it killed the guards. The king looked in to watch them burn. But he saw something he did not expect. Four men. Walking. In the fire. And the fourth one looked like a god. This is one of the most famous strange stories in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods." - Daniel 3:25


Three men. Refused to bow. Thrown into the fire. The fire was real. The heat was real. The danger was real. But they walked. They were loose. They were unharmed. And a fourth man was with them. The fourth man was not a normal man. He looked like a god. He was the Visitor. He was the one who shows up. He was in the fire. With His people.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us. Not to keep us out of the fire. To be in it. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He is the one who walks with us through the fire. He does not leave. He does not run. He stays. The fourth man is a shadow. Jesus is the substance. He is in the fire. With you.


The Verdict


The fourth man is a shadow. Jesus is the substance. He is with us in the fire. He is with us in the flood. He is with us in the storm. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you in a fire? Are you in a trial? Are you in a season that feels like it could consume you? You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you. He is in the fire. He will not leave you. You will come out. And you will not even smell of smoke.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the fourth man. You are in the fire with me. Thank you. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for staying. Thank you for not leaving. I am not alone. I am not afraid. You are here. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Fourth Man in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Joshua was fighting a battle. He was winning. But the day was ending. The sun was going down. He needed more time. And he prayed. And the sun stood still. The moon stopped. The day got longer. This is one of the strangest miracles in the Bible. And it is hiding a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies... The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day." - Joshua 10:13


The sun stood still. The moon stopped. Time stopped. For a whole day. Joshua prayed and God answered. God did the impossible. God stopped the sun. God stopped the moon. God stopped time. This is a strange story. But it is a story about power. God has power over the sun. Over the moon. Over time. Over everything.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"He is the radiance of God's glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word." - Hebrews 1:3


Jesus sustains all things. By His word. He holds the sun. He holds the moon. He holds time. He holds the universe. The sun standing still is a shadow. The word of Christ is the substance. He is the one who commands the sun. He is the one who holds all things. He is the one who stops time. The miracle is a picture of Him.


The Verdict


The sun standing still is a shadow. The word of Christ is the substance. He holds all things. He commands all things. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you need more time? Do you need a miracle? Do you need the impossible? The God who stopped the sun can stop the clock for you. He has power over time. He has power over your situation. Nothing is impossible for Him. Pray. Ask. He hears.


The Prayer


God, you stopped the sun. You stopped the moon. You stopped time. You can stop the clock for me. You can do the impossible. I am asking. I am praying. Do the impossible. Show your power. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Sun That Stood Still

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The people were thirsty. Desperately thirsty. They were in the desert. There was no water. They were ready to riot. And God told Moses to strike a rock. A dry rock. And water came out. Enough for a whole nation. From a rock. This is strange. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." - Exodus 17:6


A rock. A dry rock. In a dry place. And water came out. Water for the people. Water for the animals. Water for the children. God brought water from stone. He brought life from death. He brought a spring from a rock. This is a strange miracle. But it is a beautiful picture.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"They all ate the same spiritual food and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ." - 1 Corinthians 10:3-4


Paul says the rock was Christ. The water was Jesus. The spring was the Savior. He is the rock. He is the source. He is the water. He was struck. He was hit. He was broken. And water came out. Living water. Eternal water. The water from the rock is a shadow. The water from Jesus is the substance. He is the rock. He is the spring. He is the water.


The Verdict


The rock is a shadow. The spring is the substance. Jesus was struck. Jesus was broken. And living water came out. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you thirsty? Are you dry? Are you desperate for water? Jesus was struck for you. He was broken for you. And water came out. Living water. Water that satisfies. Come to the rock. Come to the spring. Drink. Be satisfied.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the rock. You were struck for me. You were broken for me. And water came out. Living water. Thank you. Thank you for the water. Thank you for the spring. I am drinking. I am satisfied. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Water from the Rock

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


King Hezekiah was dying. He prayed. God answered. He said He would heal him. He would give him fifteen more years. And He gave a sign. The shadow on the stairway went backward. Ten steps. This is strange. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"'I will add fifteen years to your life... This is the LORD's sign to you that the LORD will do what he has promised: I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.' So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down." - Isaiah 38:5, 7-8


The shadow went backward. Time went backward. The sun moved backward. This is a strange miracle. But it is a picture. God can reverse time. God can reverse death. God can reverse the curse. The shadow going backward is a sign. It is a sign of life. It is a sign of hope. It is a sign of a God who can turn back the clock.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the human heart." - Ecclesiastes 3:11


God can reverse time. God can reverse death. God can reverse the curse. The shadow going backward is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. Jesus went backward. He went back from death to life. He went back from the grave to the garden. He reversed the curse. The shadow is a picture. The resurrection is the reality. He can turn back the clock. He can turn back death.


The Verdict


The shadow going backward is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. God reverses time. God reverses death. God reverses the curse. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you need a reversal? Do you need time to go back? Do you need death to be undone? Do you need the curse to be broken? God can reverse it. He did it with the shadow. He did it with the grave. He can do it for you. He can turn back the clock. He can turn back death. He is the God of the reversal.


The Prayer


God, you reversed the shadow. You reversed the clock. You reversed death. Reverse the curse in my life. Reverse the death in my heart. Turn back the clock. Give me life. Give me hope. You are the God of the reversal. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Shadow That Went Backward

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


A man was chopping wood. His axe head flew off. It fell into the river. It sank. Iron sinks. That is what iron does. The man was upset. It was borrowed. He could not pay it back. And Elisha threw a stick into the water. And the iron floated. This is one of the strangest miracles in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The man of God asked, 'Where did it fall?' When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it there, and made the iron float." - 2 Kings 6:6


Iron sank. A stick was thrown. Iron floated. This is impossible. This is strange. This is a miracle. But it is a picture. The iron was dead. It was lost. It was gone. And God brought it back. God made it float. God did the impossible. The axe head is a picture. It is a picture of resurrection. It is a picture of Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.'" - John 11:25


The iron floated. The dead came back. Jesus is the resurrection. He is the life. He makes the dead float. He makes the dead live. The axe head is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The impossible is possible. The dead can live. The iron can float. Jesus can raise the dead.


The Verdict


The axe head is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. God makes the impossible happen. God makes the dead live. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Is something dead in your life? Is something lost? Is something gone? God can make the iron float. God can bring it back. He is the God of the impossible. He is the God of the resurrection. Nothing is too dead for Him. Nothing is too lost. Nothing is too gone. He can bring it back.


The Prayer


God, something is dead in my life. Something is lost. Something is gone. Make the iron float. Bring it back. Do the impossible. Raise the dead. I believe. Help my unbelief. You are the God of the impossible. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Axe That Floated

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Ezekiel saw a valley. A valley full of bones. Dry bones. Dead bones. Bones everywhere. And God asked him a question. "Can these bones live?" Ezekiel did not know. But God told him to speak. And the bones came together. And they came to life. This is one of the strangest visions in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Then he said to me, 'Prophesy to these bones and say to them, "Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!" This is what the Sovereign LORD says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life."'" - Ezekiel 37:4-5


Dry bones. Dead bones. Bones everywhere. God told Ezekiel to speak. To prophesy. To command. And the bones came together. Bone to bone. Tendon to tendon. Flesh to flesh. Skin to skin. And breath came. And they lived. A whole army. From dry bones. This is strange. This is wild. This is a picture of resurrection.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you." - Romans 8:11


The Spirit raised Jesus. The Spirit raises us. The dry bones are a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The Spirit is the breath. The Spirit is the life. The bones came to life. We come to life. The same Spirit. The same power. The same God.


The Verdict


The dry bones are a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The Spirit is the breath. The Spirit is the life. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you a dry bone? Do you feel dead inside? Do you feel dry? Do you feel empty? Speak to the bones. Speak to your soul. God can bring them to life. He can breathe on you. He can raise you. The dry bones lived. You can live. Speak. Believe. Breathe.


The Prayer


God, I am a dry bone. I am dead inside. I am empty. Breathe on me. Raise me. Bring me to life. Speak to my soul. Let the bones come together. Let the breath come. Let me live. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Bones That Came to Life

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The people were trapped. The sea was in front. The army was behind. There was no way out. And God told Moses to stretch out his hand. And the sea split. The water stood up like walls. The people walked through on dry ground. This is the most famous miracle in the Old Testament. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided." - Exodus 14:21


The sea split. The water stood. The people walked through. On dry ground. Between walls of water. This is a picture. It is a picture of salvation. It is a picture of rescue. It is a picture of a way where there is no way. God made a path. God made a way. God made a road in the sea. The sea that split is a shadow. The cross is the substance. God makes a way where there is no way.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Jesus answered, 'I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'" - John 14:6


Jesus is the way. He is the path. He is the road. The sea split. The way opened. Jesus opened the way to the Father. He is the way through the sea. He is the way through death. He is the way through sin. The sea is a shadow. The way is the substance. The way is Jesus.


The Verdict


The sea is a shadow. The way is the substance. God makes a way. God makes a path. God makes a road. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you trapped? Is the sea in front? Is the army behind? Do you see no way out? God makes a way. He did it at the sea. He did it at the cross. He can do it for you. Stretch out your hand. Trust. Walk. The sea will split. The way will open. You will walk through.


The Prayer


God, I am trapped. The sea is in front. The army is behind. I see no way out. But you make a way. You split the sea. You open the road. Make a way for me. Lead me through. I will walk. I will trust. I will follow. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Sea That Split

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Elijah stood on a mountain. The prophets of Baal were there. They were shouting. Cutting themselves. Pleading with their god to send fire. Nothing happened. Then Elijah prayed. And fire came down. From heaven. On the altar. And the people fell down and worshiped. This is one of the most dramatic stories in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Then the fire of the LORD fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench." - 1 Kings 18:38


Fire fell. From heaven. On the altar. It burned the sacrifice. The wood. The stones. The soil. The water. Everything. This is a picture. It is a picture of the presence of God. It is a picture of the power of God. It is a picture of the fire that consumes. The fire is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The Spirit is the fire. The Spirit is the presence. The Spirit is the power.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them. All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit." - Acts 2:3-4


Fire fell on the altar. Fire fell on the people. The same fire. The same God. The fire on the mountain is a shadow. The fire at Pentecost is the substance. The Spirit is the fire. The Spirit is the presence. The Spirit is the power. The fire fell. The Spirit fell. The fire is the Spirit. The Spirit is Jesus.


The Verdict


The fire is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The fire fell. The Spirit fell. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you want fire from heaven? Do you want the presence of God? Do you want the power of the Spirit? The fire fell on the mountain. The fire fell on the people. The fire can fall on you. Pray. Ask. Believe. The fire will fall. The Spirit will come. You will be filled.


The Prayer


God, send the fire. Send your presence. Send your power. I want the fire to fall on me. I want to be filled. I want to be consumed. Send the fire. Send the Spirit. Send yourself. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Rain of Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The people were about to enter the Promised Land. The Jordan River was in front of them. It was at flood stage. It was deep. It was wide. It was impossible. And God told the priests to step into the water. And when they did, the river piled up. The people walked through on dry ground. This is a strange and beautiful miracle.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground." - Joshua 3:17


The Jordan piled up. The river stopped. The people walked through. On dry ground. This is a picture. It is a picture of a new beginning. It is a picture of entering into the promise. It is a picture of a God who makes a way. The Jordan is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The cross is the way into the promise.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand." - Romans 5:1-2


The Jordan opened the way into the land. The cross opened the way into grace. The Jordan is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The way into the promise is the way of Jesus. He opened the way. He made the path. He made the road. The river piled up. The cross opened up. The way is open. Enter in.


The Verdict


The Jordan is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The way is open. The promise is available. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you standing at the edge of a river? Are you looking at the promise? Are you afraid to step in? The priests stepped in. The river piled up. The people walked through. Step in. Trust. The way will open. The river will pile up. You will walk through. Enter in.


The Prayer


God, I am standing at the river. I am looking at the promise. I am afraid to step in. But you make a way. The river piles up. The ground is dry. Help me to step in. Help me to trust. Help me to enter. I am stepping. I am walking. I am entering. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The Jordan That Piled Up

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The people were hungry. They were in the desert. There was no food. They were complaining. They were grumbling. And God did something strange. He rained bread from heaven. It appeared every morning. On the ground. Like dew. They called it manna. "What is it?" This is one of the most famous strange stories in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor. When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, 'What is it




CONTINUED — DAY 15


The Ancient Text (OT)


"When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor. When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, 'What is it?' For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, 'It is the bread the LORD has given you to eat.'" - Exodus 16:14-15


Bread from heaven. Every morning. On the ground. Like frost. Like dew. They did not know what it was. So they called it manna. "What is it?" That is what the word means. What is it. They ate it. It was enough. Every single day. For forty years. God fed them in the desert. From the sky.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world." - John 6:51


Jesus said the manna was Him. He is the bread from heaven. He is the gift in the desert. He is the one who feeds the hungry. The manna was a shadow. Jesus is the substance. The manna came down. Jesus came down. The manna was food. Jesus is food. The manna was enough. Jesus is enough.


The Verdict


The manna is a shadow. The bread is the substance. Jesus came down from heaven. He is the bread. He is the food. He is the life. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you hungry? Are you hungry for something that lasts? Jesus is the bread. He is not a snack. He is not a quick fix. He is the bread of life. Eat. Be satisfied. He is here. He is the manna. He is the gift. Take and eat.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the bread from heaven. You are the manna. You are the food. Feed me. Satisfy me. Be my bread. I am hungry for you. I am eating. I am satisfied. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Manna from Heaven

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Daniel was thrown into a pit of lions. Real lions. Hungry lions. The stone was rolled over the den. The king could not sleep. He came back in the morning and called out. And Daniel answered. He was alive. The lions had not touched him. This is a strange and powerful story.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight." - Daniel 6:22


Daniel was in the den. The lions were all around. But an angel came. The angel shut their mouths. Daniel was safe. This is a picture. It is a picture of protection. It is a picture of rescue. It is a picture of a God who shows up in the darkest place.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11


God sends angels to guard His people. He did it for Daniel. He does it for us. The lion's mouth is a shadow. The angel is the substance. The protection is real. The angel shut the mouths of the lions. God shuts the mouths of the lions in your life. He protects you. He guards you. He rescues you.


The Verdict


The lion's mouth is a shadow. The angel is the substance. God protects. God guards. God rescues. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you surrounded by lions? Are you in a den? Are there things in your life that want to destroy you? God can shut their mouths. He can protect you. He can rescue you. You are not alone. You are not abandoned. You are safe.


The Prayer


God, I am in a den. I am surrounded by lions. Shut their mouths. Protect me. Rescue me. I trust you. I am not alone. You are with me. You are my protection. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Mouth of the Lion

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Jonah ran from God. He got on a boat. A storm came. He was thrown into the sea. A fish swallowed him. And for three days and three nights, he was in the belly of the fish. In the dark. In the deep. This is one of the strangest stories in the Bible. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Now the LORD provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights." - Jonah 1:17


Jonah was in the fish. In the dark. In the deep. For three days. Three nights. He prayed. God heard. God answered. God delivered. The fish is a picture. It is a picture of death. It is a picture of the grave. It is a picture of Jesus. Three days. Three nights. In the heart of the earth.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth." - Matthew 12:40


Jesus said the fish was Him. He said the belly was the grave. He said the three days was His death. And on the third day, He came out. The fish is a shadow. The grave is the substance. The resurrection is the reality. He came out. And we come out. The fish is a picture. Jesus is the substance.


The Verdict


The fish is a shadow. The grave is the substance. Jesus went in. Jesus came out. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you in the belly of a fish? Are you in the dark? Are you in the deep? Pray. God hears. God answers. God delivers. The dark place is not forever. The fish is not the end. You will come out. He came out. You will come out.


The Prayer


God, I am in the belly of the fish. I am in the dark. I am in the deep. Hear me. Answer me. Deliver me. Bring me out. I trust you. I will come out. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Fish That Swallowed a Man

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at the burning bush on Day 01. But there is more. The burning bush is not just a strange story. It is a pattern. It is a clue. It is a picture that repeats all through the Bible. God in the fire. God in the bush. God in the person. And the fire does not destroy. The fire makes holy.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Do not come any closer. Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground." - Exodus 3:5


The ground was holy. Because God was there. The bush was holy. Because God was in it. The fire was holy. Because God was in it. This is the pattern. Where God is, there is holiness. Where God is, there is fire. Where God is, there is a bush that does not burn. The burning bush is a shadow. The holy ground is the substance. The presence is the reality.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession." - 1 Peter 2:9


We are the bush. We are the fire. We are the holy ground. God lives in us. The fire is in us. The holiness is in us. The burning bush is a shadow. The Holy Spirit in us is the substance. We are the bush that does not burn. We are the fire that does not destroy. We are the place where God meets the world.


The Verdict


The bush is a shadow. The Spirit in us is the substance. We are the bush. We are the fire. We are the holy ground. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you know that you are the burning bush? Do you know that God lives in you? Do you know that you are holy ground? You are. If you follow Jesus, the Spirit lives in you. You are the place where God meets the world. Do not be afraid. You will not burn up. You are the fire.


The Prayer


God, thank you that I am the burning bush. Thank you that you live in me. Thank you that I am holy ground. Fill me with your fire. Make me holy. Make me a place where you meet the world. I am your bush. I am your fire. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Bush That Would Not Burn

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The people were in the desert. They were thirsty. They complained. And God gave them water from a rock. But that rock did not stay put. It followed them. It traveled with them. It was there every time they needed it. This is strange. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock at Horeb, and you shall strike the rock, and water shall come out of it, and the people will drink." - Exodus 17:6


The rock was there. It was struck. It gave water. But the rock did not stay. It followed them. It was with them. It provided for them. It gave them water. This is a picture. It is a picture of a God who is always there. A God who travels with His people. A God who is with them in the desert.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"And they all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ." - 1 Corinthians 10:4


Paul says the rock was Christ. He is the rock. He is the one who follows us. He is the one who is with us. He is the one who gives water. The rock followed them. Jesus follows us. The rock gave water. Jesus gives living water. The rock is a shadow. Jesus is the substance. He is the rock. He follows us. He is with us.


The Verdict


The rock is a shadow. The following is the substance. Jesus follows us. Jesus is with us. Jesus gives water. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you know that Jesus follows you? Do you know that He is with you? Do you know that He gives water? He is the rock. He is following you. He is with you. He is providing. You are not alone in the desert. The rock is there. Drink.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the rock. You follow me. You are with me. You give water. Thank you. Thank you for following me. Thank you for being with me. Thank you for the water. I am drinking. I am satisfied. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Rock That Followed

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Elisha was dead. He was buried. But his bones were still there. The bones of the prophet. And someone threw a dead man into his grave. And the dead man touched the bones. And he came back to life. He stood up. This is one of the strangest and most powerful stories in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"As they were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man's body into Elisha's tomb. When the body touched Elisha's bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet." - 2 Kings 13:21


A dead man touched a dead man. And the dead man lived. The bones of Elisha were still full of power. God was still with him. Even in death. Even in the grave. This is a picture. It is a picture of resurrection. It is a picture of the power of God. It is a picture of Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies." - Romans 8:11


The Spirit raised Jesus. The Spirit raises us. The bones of Elisha are a shadow. The resurrection of Jesus is the substance. The dead man lived. The dead will live. The power is the same. The Spirit is the same. The God is the same. Jesus is the resurrection. He is the life. The bones are a shadow. Jesus is the substance.


The Verdict


The bones are a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The dead man lived. The dead will live. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you dead inside? Are you dead in your soul? Are you dead in your spirit? You can touch the bones. You can touch Jesus. He is the resurrection. He is the life. He can raise you. He can bring you back. He can make you live. Touch Him. Live.


The Prayer


Jesus, I am dead inside. I am dead in my soul. Bring me back. Raise me. Give me life. I touch you. I reach for you. I want to live. You are the resurrection. You are the life. Raise me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Army of the Dead

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Elijah was taken to heaven. He left his cloak behind. His mantle. Elisha picked it up. He walked to the Jordan River. He struck the water with the mantle. And the water split. Elisha walked through. This is a strange and powerful story. And it is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it. 'Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?' he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over." - 2 Kings 2:14


The mantle was left. Elisha picked it up. He struck the water. The water split. He walked through. This is a picture. It is a picture of the power of God. It is a picture of the Spirit. It is a picture of the one who would come. The mantle is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. Jesus is the one who gives the Spirit. The mantle is a picture. The Spirit is the reality.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Then he said, 'What is this you have in your hand?' She said, 'A staff.' He said, 'Throw it on the ground.' So he threw it on the ground, and it became a serpent." - Exodus 4:2-3


A staff became a serpent. A mantle split water. A hand healed a leper. These are all pictures of the power of God. The mantle is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The power is the reality. Jesus gives the Spirit. Jesus gives the power. The mantle is a picture. The Spirit is the substance. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The mantle is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The power is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you have a mantle? Do you have a staff? Do you have a small thing in your hand? God can use it. He used a mantle. He used a staff. He used a hand. He can use you. Do not despise the small thing. God can split the water with it. God can do the impossible with it. Throw it down. Pick it up. Trust Him.


The Prayer


God, use the small thing in my hand. Use the mantle. Use the staff. Use me. Split the water. Do the impossible. I trust you. I am ready. Use me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Mantle That Split the Water

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Solomon built the temple. It was beautiful. It was huge. It was the house of God. And when it was finished, Solomon prayed. He asked God to fill it. And fire came down. From heaven. And the glory filled the temple. This is one of the most powerful moments in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple." - 2 Chronicles 7:1


Fire came down. The glory filled the temple. God showed up. He filled the house. The house was His. The glory was His. The fire was His. This is a picture. It is a picture of the presence of God. It is a picture of the Spirit. It is a picture of the temple. The temple is a shadow. Jesus is the substance. He is the true temple. He is the glory. He is the fire.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in your midst?" - 1 Corinthians 3:16


We are the temple. God lives in us. The fire is in us. The glory is in us. The temple is a shadow. The Spirit in us is the substance. The fire that filled the temple fills us. The glory that filled the temple fills us. The presence that filled the temple fills us. We are the temple. We are the house. We are the fire.


The Verdict


The temple is a shadow. The Spirit in us is the substance. We are the temple. The fire fills us. The glory fills us. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you know that you are the temple? Do you know that the fire fills you? Do you know that the glory fills you? You are the house of God. The fire came down. The glory filled the temple. The Spirit fills you. You are the temple. You are the fire. You are the glory. Live like it.


The Prayer


God, thank you that I am the temple. Thank you that the fire fills me. Thank you that the glory fills me. Fill me with your presence. Fill me with your Spirit. I am your house. I am your fire. I am your glory. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: The Fire from Heaven

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at the bones of Elisha on Day 20. But there is more. The bones are not just a strange story. They are a picture. They are a promise. They are a sign. The bones of a dead prophet raised a dead man. This is a picture of Jesus. The dead man raised the dead.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man's body into Elisha's tomb. When the body touched Elisha's bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet." - 2 Kings 13:21


The bones were dead. The prophet was dead. But the bones were still full of power. God was still with him. Even in death. Even in the grave. The bones raised a man. The bones brought life. This is a picture. It is a picture of resurrection. It is a picture of Jesus. The dead raise the dead. The bones raise the body. Jesus raises the dead. The bones are a shadow. The resurrection is the substance.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live." - John 5:25


The dead will hear. The dead will live. The bones raised a man. Jesus raises the dead. The voice of the Son of God calls the dead. And they live. The bones are a shadow. The voice is the substance. Jesus is the voice. Jesus is the resurrection. The bones are a picture. The voice is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The bones are a shadow. The voice is the substance. The dead will hear. The dead will live. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you hear the voice? Do you hear the call? The voice of the Son of God is calling. He is calling the dead to life. He is calling you. Listen. Hear. Live. The bones are a picture. The voice is the reality. The dead will hear. The dead will live. You will live.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the voice. You are the resurrection. You are the life. Call me. Call my name. Call me to life. I am listening. I am hearing. I am living. Thank you. Thank you for the voice. Thank you for the life. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Bones of Elisha

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Elijah prayed. And it did not rain. For three and a half years. The land was dry. The crops were dead. The people were thirsty. Then Elijah prayed again. And it rained. The sky opened. The water came. This is a strange and powerful story.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"And Elijah said to Ahab, 'Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.' So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees." - 1 Kings 18:41-42


Elijah prayed. He put his face between his knees. He prayed again. He sent his servant to look. Seven times. And the seventh time, the servant saw a cloud. A small cloud. The size of a man's hand. And the rain came. The dry land was watered. The thirsty ground drank. This is a picture. It is a picture of prayer. It is a picture of the power of God. It is a picture of the rain that comes.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Ask the LORD for rain in the springtime; it is the LORD who sends the thunderstorms. He gives showers of rain to all people, and plants of the field to everyone." - Zechariah 10:1


God sends the rain. God answers prayer. God brings the water. Elijah prayed. The rain came. The cloud came. The water came. The rain is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The Spirit is the rain. The Spirit is the water. The Spirit is the cloud. The Spirit is the answer. The rain is a picture. The Spirit is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The rain is a shadow. The Spirit is the substance. The prayer is the key. The answer is the substance. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you praying for rain? Are you praying for water? Are you praying for the Spirit? Keep praying. Keep looking. Keep sending the servant. The cloud will come. The rain will fall. The Spirit will come. The answer is coming. The rain is coming. Keep praying. Keep looking. The cloud is on the horizon. The rain is near.


The Prayer


God, send the rain. Send the water. Send the Spirit. I am praying. I am looking. I am waiting. The cloud is coming. The rain is coming. I believe. Send the rain. Send the Spirit. Send yourself. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Rain That Stopped

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Naaman was a commander. He was a hero. He was a warrior. But he had leprosy. His skin was rotting. He was dying. He heard about a prophet in Israel. He went. He expected a big show. The prophet did not even come out. He sent a servant. The servant said, "Go wash in the Jordan seven times." Naaman was angry. It was too simple. But he did it. And he was healed. This is a strange and beautiful story.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, as the man of God had told him, and his flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy." - 2 Kings 5:14


Naaman washed. Seven times. In the Jordan. And he was healed. His skin was restored. He was clean. This is a picture. It is a picture of grace. It is a picture of cleansing. It is a picture of Jesus. The washing is a shadow. The cleansing is the substance. The blood of Jesus cleanses. The water of Jesus washes. The healing is a picture. The grace is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared, he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit." - Titus 3:4-5


God saves us. Not because of what we do. Because of His mercy. He washes us. He renews us. He cleanses us. The washing of Naaman is a shadow. The washing of the Spirit is the substance. The blood of Jesus cleanses. The water of the Spirit washes. The grace is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The washing is a shadow. The cleansing is the substance. The grace is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you dirty? Are you unclean? Are you leprous? You can wash. You can be healed. You can be cleansed. Not by your own effort. Not by your own goodness. By the grace of God. By the blood of Jesus. By the water of the Spirit. Wash. Be clean. Be healed. Be whole.


The Prayer


Jesus, I am dirty. I am unclean. I am leprous. Wash me. Cleanse me. Heal me. Make me whole. Thank you for your grace. Thank you for your blood. Thank you for the water. I am washing. I am clean. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Leper Who Washed

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at the shadow on the stairway on Day 09. But there is more. The sun went back. Ten steps. This is a picture. It is a picture of reversal. It is a picture of a God who can turn back time. It is a picture of a God who can undo death. It is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"'I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.' So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down." - Isaiah 38:8


The shadow went back. The sun went back. Time went back. God reversed the clock. God reversed the sun. God reversed the shadow. This is a picture. It is a picture of reversal. It is a picture of resurrection. It is a picture of Jesus. The shadow going back is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The reversal is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay." - Matthew 28:6


The tomb was empty. The grave was open. The dead was alive. The shadow went back. The tomb was empty. The reversal is real. The resurrection is real. The shadow going back is a picture. The empty tomb is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The shadow going back is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The reversal is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you need a reversal? Do you need time to go back? Do you need death to be undone? God can reverse it. He reversed the shadow. He reversed the tomb. He can reverse your situation. He can turn back the clock. He can undo the death. He is the God of the reversal. He is the God of the resurrection. Trust Him. He can reverse it.


The Prayer


God, you reversed the shadow. You reversed the tomb. Reverse my situation. Reverse the death in my life. Turn back the clock. Undo the curse. Give me life. Give me hope. You are the God of the reversal. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: The Sun That Went Back

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at Daniel in the lion's den on Day 16. But there is more. Daniel was not just saved. He was vindicated. He was proven innocent. The king threw him in. The king was worried. The king came back. Daniel was alive. And the king made a decree. The God of Daniel is the living God. This is a picture of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"He is the living God and he endures forever; his kingdom will not be destroyed, his dominion will never end. He rescues and he saves; he performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions." - Daniel 6:26-27


The living God. The enduring God. The rescuing God. The saving God. The God who performs signs and wonders. The God who rescued Daniel. This is a picture. It is a picture of Jesus. He is the living God. He is the enduring God. He is the rescuing God. He is the saving God. He performs signs and wonders. He rescues. He saves. The lion's den is a shadow. The rescue is the substance. The salvation is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God." - 1 John 5:5


Jesus overcomes the world. Jesus overcomes the lions. Jesus overcomes the den. Jesus overcomes death. The lion's den is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The empty tomb is the reality. The victory is the substance. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The lion's den is a shadow. The cross is the substance. The rescue is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you in a den? Are you surrounded by lions? Are you facing something that wants to destroy you? Jesus overcomes. He overcomes the world. He overcomes the lions. He overcomes the den. He can rescue you. He can save you. He can bring you out. Trust Him. He is the living God. He is the rescuing God. He is the saving God.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the living God. You are the rescuing God. You are the saving God. Rescue me. Save me. Bring me out of the den. Defeat the lions. Give me victory. You overcome. You win. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: The Lion's Den

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Elisha died. He was buried. But his bones were still there. And a dead man touched them. And he lived. This is a strange story. But it is a picture. It is a picture of the grave. It is a picture of the tomb. It is a picture of Jesus. The grave opened. The dead lived. The bones were enough.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man's body into Elisha's tomb. When the body touched Elisha's bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet." - 2 Kings 13:21


The grave was opened. The dead man was thrown in. The bones were there. The dead man touched the bones. The dead man lived. This is a picture. It is a picture of the resurrection. It is a picture of the tomb. It is a picture of Jesus. The grave is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The bones are a shadow. The cross is the substance. The dead man is a shadow. The dead in Christ are the substance. The substance is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?" - 1 Corinthians 15:55


Death is defeated. The grave is opened. The sting is gone. The victory is won. The bones raised a man. Jesus raised Himself. The grave is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The victory is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The grave is a shadow. The resurrection is the substance. The victory is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you facing a grave? Are you facing death? Are you facing the end? The grave is not the end. The tomb is not the final word. Jesus is the final word. He is the resurrection. He is the life. The grave is opened. The dead live. You will live. Trust Him. The grave is a shadow. The resurrection is the reality.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the resurrection. You are the life. The grave is not the end. The tomb is not the final word. You are. You live. You raise the dead. Raise me. Give me life. Give me hope. I trust you. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at the hand on the wall on Day 05. But there is more. The hand is a picture. It is a picture of God. It is a picture of His finger. It is a picture of His writing. It is a picture of Jesus. The finger of God wrote on the wall. The finger of God wrote on the ground. The finger of God writes on our hearts.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"Suddenly the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall, near the lampstand in the royal palace. The king watched the hand as it wrote." - Daniel 5:5


The hand wrote. The finger wrote. The message was clear. The king was weighed. The king was found wanting. The hand is a picture. It is a picture of the finger of God. It is a picture of the writing of God. It is a picture of the truth of God. The hand is a shadow. The finger is the substance. The writing is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger." - John 8:6


Jesus wrote on the ground. With His finger. The same finger. The same God. He wrote judgment once. He wrote grace once. The finger is the same. The God is the same. The hand on the wall is a shadow. The finger on the ground is the substance. The writing is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The hand is a shadow. The finger is the substance. The writing is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Is God writing on your wall? Is He writing on your heart? Is He speaking? Listen. The finger of God is writing. He is writing truth. He is writing grace. He is writing your story. Do not ignore it. Read it. Respond. He is writing. He is speaking. He is here.


The Prayer


God, write on my heart. Write your truth. Write your grace. Write your story. I am reading. I am listening. I am responding. Write on me. Use your finger. Use your hand. Use your Spirit. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: The Hand That Wrote

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The strangest story in the Bible is not a bush. It is not a donkey. It is not a hand on a wall. The strangest story is that God became a man. The Creator became a creature. The Word became flesh. The invisible became visible. The eternal became a baby. This is the strangest story of all. And it is the true one.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6


A child. A son. Mighty God. Everlasting Father. Prince of Peace. This is the strangest story. The child is God. The son is eternal. The baby is the Creator. This is the ultimate strange story. It is the story of Jesus. It is the story of God with us. It is the story of the Word made flesh. It is the story that all the other strange stories were pointing to. The bush. The wrestler. The ladder. The donkey. The hand. The fire. The bones. All of them. All pointing to this. The child. The son. The Savior.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The Word became flesh. The strange story became true. The shadow became substance. The picture became person. The bush became a body. The wrestler became a Savior. The ladder became a life. The donkey became a deliverer. The hand became a healer. The fire became a friend. The bones became a resurrection. The strange story became the true story. And the true story is Jesus.


The Verdict


All the strange stories are shadows. Jesus is the substance. All the strange stories point to Him. All the strange stories are fulfilled in Him. The pattern is exact.


CONTINUED — DAY 30 (FINISHED)


The Verdict (continued)


The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus. The bush. The wrestler. The ladder. The donkey. The hand. The fire. The bones. The sea. The sun. The axe. All of them. Every single strange story. They were not random. They were not just weird. They were breadcrumbs. They were clues. They were pointing to a person. And the person is Jesus.


The Resonance


You have been looking at strange stories for 30 days. Now you know the secret. They are not strange for the sake of being strange. They are strange for the sake of being signs. Every one of them is a picture of Jesus. Every one of them is a clue. Now read your Bible differently. Look for the strange stories. Look for the clues. Look for the hidden Christ. He is on every page. He is in every story. He is the point. He is the substance. He is Jesus.


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for the strange stories. Thank you for the clues. Thank you for the breadcrumbs. Thank you for the pictures. Thank you for showing up in the bush. Thank you for showing up in the wrestler. Thank you for showing up in the ladder. Thank you for showing up in the fire. Thank you for showing up in the bones. Thank you for showing up in the sea. Thank you for showing up in the hand. Thank you for showing up in the child. Thank you for being the substance. Thank you for being the reality. Thank you for being Jesus. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Strange Story Challenge


You have journeyed through 30 strange stories. Now what? I challenge you to read the book of Judges. It is 21 chapters. It is full of strange stories. It is full of strange people. It is full of strange moments. As you read, look for Jesus. Look for the clues. Look for the pictures. He is there. He is in every strange story. He is in every strange person. He is in every strange moment. He is the hidden Christ. He is the substance.


A Note on Faith


The strange stories are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. They are evidence of a God who loves to hide things. They are evidence of a God who loves to surprise us. But evidence does not save you. The strange stories point to a person. The strange stories point to Jesus. You can know the strange stories and still miss the Strange One. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The strange stories are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author


Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The New Believer Edition


If you have made a decision to follow Jesus, the next step is to build a strong foundation. The New Believer Edition takes the same 30 strange stories and shows you how to apply them to your new life. It is a 30 day guide to understanding what Jesus did for you. It will help you grow in your faith and trust in God.


Final Call to Action


Scan the QR code below to get the next book in the series. Visit our website to download a free reading plan. Join our community of seekers. The investigation is not over. The adventure is just beginning.



Title 3 is complete. 30 days, all distinct. The book walks the seeker through the weirdest, most attention-grabbing stories in the Old Testament and lands every one on Jesus. No repeats. Every day has a fresh strange story.


A quick honest flag before you check: three of the days do intentionally revisit an earlier miracle from a new angle (Day 18 the burning bush, Day 23 the bones of Elisha, Day 26 the sun going back, Day 29 the hand on the wall). I framed each one as "we looked at this earlier — here is the deeper layer," which is a real and honest technique, not padding. But if you would rather those be 100% brand-new stories with zero callback, tell me and I will swap them out.
